refinements.outcome: E22 separates approved production SLO/capacity policy, stateful HA topology, ingress/rollout, isolated backup/restore and end-to-end failover evidence into five owner-scoped stories.
refinements.context: Current platform_infrastructure/compose.yaml is a single-host local stack: one PostgreSQL server, one Kafka broker/controller, Redis AOF and Keycloak with local cache and a PostgreSQL database. All five stories have owner-specific leaf specifications; none establishes production HA without approved targets and real drills.

refinements.outcome: S01 produces approved, versioned production service-level/capacity targets from measured baselines and cost/failure-domain assumptions before HA implementation.
refinements.context: No approved numeric SLO, RTO/RPO, peak load, cost or region topology appears in the checked-in infrastructure; writing numbers without ProductOwner/SRE sign-off would be fabrication.

refinements.outcome: S02 pins Postgres, Kafka, Redis and Keycloak failure-domain design and recovery invariants with a fenced-writer disposable rehearsal; local Compose remains development-only.
refinements.context: Postgres includes a separate Keycloak database in the local container; Kafka uses one broker/controller; Redis uses AOF but does not automatically become safe multi-node cache. All production choices await S01.

refinements.outcome: S03 specifies multi-node ingress, routing and rolling service rollout with reproducible compatibility, identity and rollback gates.
refinements.context: Local Compose and host-based ingress are development topology, not proof of replicated routing, independent failure domains or production traffic migration.

refinements.outcome: S04 specifies encrypted isolated backups, point-in-time database recovery and measured restore/reconciliation across service, identity and event boundaries.
refinements.context: Local persistent volumes and Redis AOF do not establish off-site backup, retention, Keycloak restoration or PITR. Production storage and retention require approval.

refinements.outcome: S05 proves end-to-end failover/failback using versioned runbooks, fault injection, measured user-visible outcomes and explicit go/no-go evidence.
refinements.context: Synthetic/local drills establish procedure only; production acceptance requires approved S01 targets, S02–S04 implementation and independently reviewed evidence.

additions.summary: [VS-E22-S01-ST01] Version production SLO RTO RPO capacity and cost decision contract
additions.actor: ViStay SRE, architecture reviewer or release operator
additions.outcome: Contracts gives approvers one reproducible service-level register with measured and target fields, precise owners, risk acceptance and activation gates, without inventing target values.
additions.context: E22 baseline requires versioned SLO, RTO, RPO, capacity and cost before production HA. Existing Compose service health checks are not SLO or DR evidence.
inScope: Define per-critical-journey availability/latency/error-budget measurement for sign-in, inventory/quote, booking confirmation, Finance collection and customer/admin reads with trace and denominator semantics.

Record baseline sample window, peak/steady traffic, DB sizes, events/lag, currency/booking data criticality, geographic failure domains, projected capacity and cost; distinguish measured observations from proposed/approved targets.

Require ProductOwner/SRE approval fingerprint and effective date for target SLO, RTO, RPO, maximum data loss, maintenance policy and budget; unresolved fields produce NOT_APPROVED and block HA activation.

outOfScope: Publishing numeric production targets or paid infrastructure capacity without owner approval.

artifacts: versioned SLO/RTO/RPO and capacity decision register

interfaces: Version read-only resilience policy manifest consumed by infrastructure checks and DR gates; missing or unapproved target never resolves to a production default.
dataOwnership: Contracts stores approved policy and its evidence only; Infrastructure measures and owns deployment, services retain authoritative data.
stateMachine: DRAFT -> MEASURED -> REVIEWED -> APPROVED -> SUPERSEDED; only approved effective version may authorize production HA acceptance.

dataPartitions: SYSTEM deployment and approved SRE/DBA roles only; SITE/BRANCH domain data remains scoped by its service even during failover.
fieldGroups: SUMMARY targets/status; INTERNAL_AUDIT cost, production topology and approvers restricted.

failureSemantics: Fail closed on missing approved capacity/SLO, failover quorum, authentication, secret references or valid restore evidence; never label a local single-node smoke run as production HA.

Exclude production secrets, raw customer records, private DB backups and access tokens from logs or Jira evidence.
idempotencyConcurrency: Recovery tests replay outbox/inbox events and compare business keys so Booking inventory, Payment/Finance money and Notifications remain at-most-once in effect.

Backup/restore artifacts have immutable manifest ID and checksums; repeating an isolated drill never writes into a live service database.

additions.summary: [VS-E22-S02-ST02] Specify stateful recovery invariants and source reconciliation
additions.actor: ViStay SRE, architecture reviewer or release operator
additions.outcome: Contracts defines owner-specific failover and DR invariants for Postgres, Kafka, Redis and Keycloak so replica recovery never silently loses or duplicates critical business effects.
additions.context: Local Kafka single controller/broker and shared PostgreSQL process lack a production failover guarantee; cache AOF is not authorization/monetary authority.
inScope: Pin per-service DB/Keycloak backup boundary, WAL/transaction position, schema migration compatibility and checksum; no cross-service DB reads during recovery.
Define Kafka producer acknowledgement/consumer inbox/outbox replay, ordered aggregate revision and partition ownership after leader change; stale producer must be fenced.
Define Redis lost/rebuilt cache fail-closed authorization and no payment/booking authoritative rows in cache; Keycloak session/token validation after failover and clock/key compatibility.
Add deterministic split-brain, partial WAL restore, old broker message replay, missing Redis grant, Keycloak expired session and Finance paid-vs-waived mismatch fixtures with reconciliation criteria.
outOfScope: Choosing a commercial cloud provider, numeric RPO or replication quorum as already approved.
interfaces: Version recovery epoch/owner manifest with DB WAL position, Kafka consumer checkpoint and Keycloak key version; Infrastructure drill checks these before accepting failover.
dataOwnership: PostgreSQL/Keycloak store authoritative identities and service data; Kafka transports events; Redis cache is never source of truth; each domain service performs own reconciliation.
stateMachine: CANDIDATE_RESTORE -> RECONCILED -> ACCEPTED or REJECTED; incomplete source manifest cannot advance to ACCEPTED.

dataPartitions: SYSTEM deployment and approved SRE/DBA roles only; SITE/BRANCH domain data remains scoped by its service even during failover.

Backup/restore artifacts have immutable manifest ID and checksums; repeating an isolated drill never writes into a live service database.
